newsitem.title: CHINA: Dalian soybeans end mostly up, sentiment improves.
newsitem.headline: Dalian soybeans end mostly up, sentiment improves.

text.p: Dalian soybean futures ended mostly higher on Tuesday on improved market sentiment amid short-covering and speculative buying, traders said.
The key November 1997 contract ended at an intraday high of 2,857 yuan ($344) per tonne, rising 13 yuan. It opened at 2,846 yuan, hitting an intraday low of 2,840 and a high of 2,862.
"Speculative buying and short-covering at low levels pushed most of the contracts up today, expecially in the later-maturing contracts, which improved market sentiment," one trader said.
